Dear Mr Barlow,

Re: Preparing rental income schedules for your property at Flat 3B, 74 The Crescent, Huddersfield HD9 9LN

Thank you for instructing us. This letter sets out the basis on which we will be preparing rental income schedules for your property at Flat 3B, 74 The Crescent, Huddersfield HD9 9LN.

What we will do
- submit the return to HMRC after you have approved it
- advise you of payments on account and deadlines
- deal with routine correspondence from HMRC
- prepare quarterly VAT returns and file them through Making Tax Digital software

Tetiana Hrytsenko, Director, will have overall responsibility for your matter. Day-to-day work will be carried out by Antony Steele, Trainee Solicitor, who you can contact on 023 3478 2946 or antony.steele@penrosehale.co.uk. If Antony is unavailable, please ask for Mrs Hrytsenko.

Fees and expenses
Our charges are based on the time spent. The current hourly rates are £400.00 for a partner and £195.00 for other fee earners, plus VAT. We estimate the total cost at £2,350 to £3,950 plus VAT and disbursements.

Anti-money laundering checks
Under the Money Laundering Regulations 2017 we must verify your identity. Please bring your passport or photocard driving licence and a utility bill dated within the last three months.

Complaints
If you are unhappy with our service, please contact Tetiana Hrytsenko. You may also complain to the Chartered Institute of Taxation.

Data protection
Our privacy notice explains how we use and protect your information. We will use your personal data only to provide our services and to meet our legal obligations under the Data Protection Act 2018. 

Timescales
We will keep you informed of progress and let you know if anything is likely to cause a delay. 

Cancellation
If you ask us to start work during the cancellation period you will pay for the work done up to the date you cancel. 

Limitation of liability
Our liability to you for any loss arising from this engagement is limited to £1,500,000, unless the law does not allow such a limit. 

Our terms of business are enclosed and form part of this letter. Please sign and return the enclosed copy.

Regards,
Tetiana Hrytsenko
Partner
Penrose Hale Chartered Accountants
